name: Smolder
notes: Opens with MMOOOMMMM! (R) at t=0; the dummy is assumed to stand in the wave's 125-unit center sweetspot (the natural placement for a single stationary target directly ahead), so R's physical damage uses the 1.5x sweetspot multiplier. R's self heal is ignored since it never changes damage dealt to the dummy.

Dragon Practice (P) stacks start at 0 and accumulate only from hits actually landed during the fight: Q, W, E and R each grant a stack the first time they hit the dummy, capped as the dossier states (one stack per Q cast since Q can only hit once per cast anyway, one stack ever from W since it only grants a stack on its first hit against a given champion, and one stack per E cast regardless of bolt count). Q's kill-related bonus-stack text is not modeled since the dummy is never treated as dying.

Because stacks start at 0 and only a handful of casts fit in an 8-15s fight, Q's stack-gated tiers (25/125/225 stacks) are effectively unreachable; the tier 1/2/3 logic is implemented for correctness but will almost never fire in a short dummy fight.

The crit-scaling term in Dragon Practice's Q/E bonus damage and in Q's own physical damage is applied exactly as Riot's extracted formula strings show it: an additive bonus of ratio x critChance x (critDamage-1), not a multiplicative crit strike. This is the resolved reading of an ambiguous formula.

If Q ever reaches tier 2 (125 stacks), all of its arc bolts are assumed to land on the single dummy (a multi-hit reading), each dealing 50% of the fireball's damage (physical and Dragon Practice bonus alike) per the wiki's stated multiplier.
W's repeat-explosion decay (75% of the previous explosion's damage) is treated as persisting for the whole fight against the one dummy target, since there is nowhere else for it to reset.

E is a 1.25s channel: it is cast on cooldown whenever off cooldown and Smolder is not locked into R's 0.75s cast; casting Q or W is paused for its duration (per the dossier, another cast would end it early) and Smolder's attacks are held until it ends. All of its bolts (5 + stacks/100, rounded down) are resolved as a single batch when the channel ends; its cooldown starts at the cast, per the wiki's cdstart note.
Q and W are cast on cooldown whenever not blocked by E's channel or R's cast lock; basic attacks fill every other window.

Q's tier-3 true-damage burn (unreachable in-fight, see above) is modeled, if ever triggered, as an instant application of its full 3-second total rather than three separate ticks, and the 6.5% execute threshold is not modeled, since this code path cannot actually be reached inside the simulated fight length.
Mana is not modeled: no base mana or regen values were available, and Smolder's costs are small relative to an 8-15s fight.

assumed.why: Dragon Practice has no stated starting value and is uncapped; a fresh fight is assumed to start at 0 stacks, accumulated only from hits landed during the simulated window
the dummy is assumed to stand in MMOOOMMMM!'s center sweetspot, the natural placement for a single stationary target directly ahead in a fight with no positioning
